text: {"lessons":["A falling account value is uncomfortable, but it doesn’t by itself mean I should sell or buy more; I should decide based on my goals and current information.","I tend to resist admitting a purchase was a mistake, so I should reassess each holding on its merits rather than cling to its average cost.","I made no trades during these periods; I should review my portfolio periodically and make deliberate choices, without assuming past price moves predict what comes next."]}
